messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, I saw {ff 00 00 06}{04 16 00} {ff 00 00 00}and
{ff 00 00 06}{04 17 00} {ff 00 00 00}gazing into
each other's eyes...
Yeah!{01 00 00 05 00} Just the other day!{01 00 00 05 00}
I think they were having
a staring contest!
{07 14 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Wait, what? You think
something funny's going on,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, ma nägin {ff 00 00 06}{04 16 00} {ff 00 00 00}ja
{ff 00 00 06}{04 17 00} {ff 00 00 00}teineteisele
silma vaatamas...
Jah!{01 00 00 05 00} Alles üleeile!{01 00 00 05 00}
Ma arvan, et neil oli
jõllitamisvõistlus!
{07 14 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Oota, mis? Sa arvad, et
midagi on imelikku,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Wouldn't it be funny if
{ff 00 00 06}{04 16 00} {ff 00 00 00}and {ff 00 00 06}{04 17 00}
{ff 00 00 00}{07 14 00}turned out to be brothers?
{07 03 00}Then again,{01 00 00 05 00} it would be
HILARIOUS if they were
sisters, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kas poleks naljakas, kui
{ff 00 00 06}{04 16 00} {ff 00 00 00}ja {ff 00 00 06}{04 17 00}
{ff 00 00 00}{07 14 00}osutuksid vendadeks?
{07 03 00}Teisalt,{01 00 00 05 00} oleks NALJAKAS, kui
nad oleksid õed,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 13 00}I'll bet they were drinking
{04 13 00} together
or something, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 17 00}Of course, they probably
got one tall glass and two
straws, too, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 13 00}Vean kihla, et nad jõid
koos {04 13 00}
või midagi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 17 00}Muidugi võtsid nad ilmselt
ühe pika klaasi ja kaks
kõrt, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}I'll bet it's because
{ff 00 00 06}{04 16 00}{ff 00 00 00} stole some of
{ff 00 00 06}{04 17 00}{ff 00 00 00}'s flowers!
It has to be! It just HAS
to, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 06 00}Man, I'd have shared my
{04 13 00} {01 00 00 05 00}if I
thought it'd help!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Vean kihla, et see on sest
{ff 00 00 06}{04 16 00}{ff 00 00 00} varastas
{ff 00 00 06}{04 17 00}{ff 00 00 00} lilli!
See peab nii olema! Lihtsalt
PEAB, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 06 00}Mees, oleksin jaganud oma
{04 13 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}kui
arvanuks, et see aitab!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}This has to be all because
{ff 00 00 06}{04 17 00}{ff 00 00 00} made fun of
{ff 00 00 06}{04 16 00}{ff 00 00 00}'s outfit!
Yeah, that's gotta be it,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 16 00}That kid's been{01 00 00 05 00} collecting
{04 14 00} clothes lately,
so...
{07 15 00}Just goes to show you,{01 00 00 05 00}
you gotta let people do
their things, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}See kõik peab olema sest
{ff 00 00 06}{04 17 00}{ff 00 00 00} naeris
{ff 00 00 06}{04 16 00}{ff 00 00 00} riiete üle!
Jah, see peab olema,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 16 00}See laps on{01 00 00 05 00} viimasel ajal
{04 14 00} riideid kogunud,
nii et...
{07 15 00}See näitabki,{01 00 00 05 00}
et sa pead laskma inimestel
oma asja ajada, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}The thing is, {01 00 00 05 00}I don't get all
caught up in what the
ladies think...
So I guess it doesn't really
matter, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Asi on selles, {01 00 00 05 00}et mind ei
huvita eriti, mida daamid
arvavad...
Nii et vist pole see
tähtis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0d 00}I'd like to become best 
friends like that with you, 
{04 1f 00}! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}Ma tahaksin saada sinuga 
sama headeks sõpradeks, 
{04 1f 00}! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 02 00}That's it! {01 00 00 05 00}I got it!


{07 00 00}The bud that treats you
the best is the one you 
call your...
{07 15 00}BEST BUD! {01 00 00 05 00}Gah! {01 00 00 05 00}Finally,
I understand, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 02 00}See on see! {01 00 00 05 00}Ma sain aru!


{07 00 00}Semu, kes kohtleb sind
kõige paremini, on see, 
keda sa kutsud...
{07 15 00}PARIM SEMU! {01 00 00 05 00}Gah! {01 00 00 05 00}Lõpuks
ma mõistan, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 02 00}That's it!


{07 00 00}Rivals compliment you,{01 00 00 05 00} but
then smack you around!{01 00 00 05 00}
They're just so fired up!
